Dialog.Recover.Zh:

请联系该服务器管理员处理，登录器不会改写账号数据库或绕过密码验证。
Dialog.Recover.En:
This CSNZ server has no email or SMS password-recovery interface.

Contact the server administrator. The launcher will not edit the account database or bypass password verification.

Dialog.Help.Zh:
1. 设置中选择本机、局域网 / VPN 开服、互联网开服或加入服务器。Ready 仅表示大厅协议响应。
2. 开服时，大厅连接地址用 127.0.0.1；对局通告地址填玩家可访问的局域网、VPN 或公网 IPv4。
3. 默认大厅 TCP 30002、对局 UDP 27015；公网需自行映射相同端口并放行防火墙，无公网 IPv4 可用 VPN。
4. 加入模式只准备本机资源，不启动本地服务端，不加载客户端武器 DLL。未知自定义资源拒绝覆盖，首次更新会询问并备份。
5. TLS 必须与大厅一致；远程明文登录 / 注册会提示风险。切换服务器会清空已保存凭据。
6. 安全停止正常关闭本登录器管理的 CSOHLDS 和大厅；其他玩家将断线，不强杀未知进程。

不修改原游戏 EXE/DLL 或账户数据库；首次创建角色仍在游戏内完成。
Dialog.Help.En:
1. Choose Local, Host LAN/VPN, Host Internet, or Join in Settings. Ready only confirms the lobby protocol response.
2. Hosts connect to the local lobby at 127.0.0.1 and advertise a LAN, VPN or public IPv4 reachable by players.
3. Default ports: lobby TCP 30002 and game UDP 27015. Internet hosts must configure same-port forwarding/firewall rules; use a VPN without public IPv4.
4. Join mode only prepares local assets, never starts local servers or loads client weapon DLLs. Unknown custom assets are refused; updates ask first and create backups.
5. TLS must match the lobby. Remote plaintext login/registration requires a risk confirmation. Changing servers clears saved credentials.
6. Safe stop gracefully closes owned CSOHLDS and the lobby; other players disconnect. Unknown processes are never force-killed.

Original game EXE/DLL files and account databases are unchanged; first character creation remains in-game.

Close.Confirm.Zh:
是否同时安全停止由本登录器启动的服务端？其他联机玩家也会断开连接。

是：保存并停止服务端，然后退出。
否：保留服务端运行，仅退出登录器。
Close.Confirm.En:
Also safely stop the servers started by this launcher? Other connected players will be disconnected.

Yes: save and stop the servers, then exit.
No: leave the servers running and exit only the launcher.

Native.GameFileMissing.Zh: 缺少游戏文件：{0}。请确认游戏目录及文件是否完整；只加入他人的服务器不需要本地 CSOHLDS.exe。
Native.GameFileMissing.En: Game file missing: {0}. Check the selected directory and installation. Joining another server does not require a local CSOHLDS.exe.

Native.GameFormat.Zh: 游戏文件不是有效的 32 位 Windows EXE/DLL：{0}。请检查文件是否损坏或选错版本。
Native.GameFormat.En: Game file is not a valid 32-bit Windows EXE/DLL: {0}. Check for corruption or an incorrect architecture.

Native.Missing.Zh: 原生补丁文件不存在：{0}。请重新启动登录器以释放内嵌补丁。
Native.Missing.En: The native patch file was not found: {0}. Restart the launcher to extract its embedded patch.

Native.EntryMissing.En: The native component entry point {0} was not found.

Native.InitError.Zh: 原生组件初始化返回错误 {0}。

Plugins.Description.Zh: 选择游戏功能插件。更改自动保存，并应用于本地服务端。
Plugins.Description.En: Select game-system plugins. Changes are saved automatically and applied to the local server.

Plugins.Waiting.Zh: 等待本地服务端启动；尚未加载。
Plugins.Waiting.En: Waiting for the local server. Not loaded.

Plugins.Active.Zh: 已加载 C++ 原生插件 · 服务端 PID {0}

Plugins.Disabled.Zh: 已停用修复；已解锁槽位和已有装备保留。
Plugins.Disabled.En: Repair disabled. Unlocked slots and equipped traits are preserved.

Plugins.LocalOnly.Zh: 仅支持所选游戏目录的本地服务端；不修改远程服务端。
Plugins.LocalOnly.En: Local server only. Remote servers are not modified.

Plugins.SelectRoot.Zh: 请先在 Settings 中选择有效的游戏目录。
Plugins.SelectRoot.En: Select a valid game folder in Settings first.

Plugins.ObserverFailed.Zh: 配对武器诊断未就绪（不代表服务端修复停用）：{0}
Plugins.ObserverFailed.En: Paired-weapon diagnostics unavailable (server repair is separate): {0}

Plugins.ShortActive.Zh: 已加载 · Class Awakening 已启用。

Plugins.ShortWaiting.Zh: 已选择 · 本地服务端就绪后自动加载。
Plugins.ShortWaiting.En: Selected · Class Awakening will load when the local server is ready.

Plugins.ShortDisabled.Zh: 未选择 · Class Awakening 已停用。
Plugins.ShortDisabled.En: Not selected · Class Awakening is disabled.

Plugins.ShortError.Zh: 状态异常 · 将鼠标悬停于此查看详情。
Plugins.ShortError.En: Status unavailable · Hover here for details.

Weapons.UnknownIds.Zh: 设置中存在未知武器 ID：{0}。

Weapons.BundleFormat.Zh: 原生武器组件清单、API 或资源校验不匹配。
Weapons.BundleFormat.En: Native weapon manifest, API or asset validation failed.

Weapons.DllLoad.Zh: 无法验证原生组件 {0}（Windows 错误 {1}）。

Weapons.ConfigFormat.Zh: 服务端配置缺少 Room 或 DedicatedServerWhitelist，未做任何修改。
Weapons.ConfigFormat.En: The server configuration is missing Room or DedicatedServerWhitelist; nothing was changed.

Weapons.UnknownAsset.Zh: 发现未知或自定义资源包，已拒绝覆盖：{0}。请先人工合并资源。
Weapons.UnknownAsset.En: Refusing to overwrite an unknown or custom asset pack: {0}. Merge its assets manually first.

Weapons.PrepareWhileRunning.Zh: 准备武器资源前，请关闭游戏、CSOHLDS 和大厅服务端；不会强行停止外部进程。
Weapons.PrepareWhileRunning.En: Close the game, CSOHLDS and lobby server before asset preparation. External processes will not be terminated.

Weapons.PreparationChanged.Zh: 准备期间配置或资源发生变化，已取消操作。
Weapons.PreparationChanged.En: Configuration or assets changed during preparation; the operation was canceled.

Weapons.RestartRequired.Zh: 请先关闭游戏并停止本登录器的本地服务端，再切换武器或安装目录。
Weapons.RestartRequired.En: Close the game and stop the local server before changing weapons or the game folder.

Weapons.NativeFailed.Zh: 原生武器模块已拒绝启动或自动停用。请保留日志：{0}。
Weapons.NativeFailed.En: Native weapon modules refused startup or disabled themselves. Keep this log: {0}.

Weapons.PrepareFirst.Zh: 尚未完成本地武器资源与专用服务端配置准备。
Weapons.PrepareFirst.En: Local weapon assets and dedicated server settings have not been prepared.

Weapons.ExistingServer.Zh: 已有 CSOHLDS 运行。本登录器不会向未知实例注入，请先正常关闭它。
Weapons.ExistingServer.En: CSOHLDS is already running. This launcher will not inject an unknown instance; close it normally first.

Weapons.StartFailed.Zh: 本地 CSOHLDS 未能启动或提前退出。
Weapons.StartFailed.En: The local CSOHLDS failed to start or exited early.

Weapons.ModuleTimeout.Zh: 等待 CSOHLDS 引擎模块超时，未启动客户端。
Weapons.ModuleTimeout.En: Timed out waiting for CSOHLDS engine modules; the client was not started.

Weapons.WrongProcess.Zh: 服务端进程路径不匹配，已拒绝加载武器模块。
Weapons.WrongProcess.En: The server process path does not match; weapon loading was refused.

Weapons.StopTimeout.Zh: CSOHLDS 尚未退出，已保留进程；请手动检查后再启动。
Weapons.StopTimeout.En: CSOHLDS has not exited. The process was preserved; check it manually before restarting.

Weapons.PreparePrompt.Zh: 为 {0} 准备本地武器修复？将备份后更新 Data/fixtrike.nar，并把房间改为专用服务端模式，保留其他配置。不会修改游戏 DLL、账户或背包。未知自定义资源包不会被覆盖。
Weapons.PreparePrompt.En: Prepare local weapon repairs for {0}? After backing up, this updates Data/fixtrike.nar and switches rooms to dedicated-server mode, preserving other settings. Game DLLs, accounts and inventory remain unchanged. Unknown custom packs are never overwritten.

Weapons.Prepared.Zh: 武器资源准备完成。回退备份：{0}。

Weapons.StatusFailed.Zh: 读取原生武器状态失败：{0}。

Weapons.Active.Zh: 服务端正在运行 {0} 项模块 · 已完成地图资源预缓存
Weapons.Active.En: Server running {0} modules - map assets precached

Weapons.WaitingMap.Zh: 专用服务端挂接就绪 · 等待房间首次地图预缓存
Weapons.WaitingMap.En: Dedicated server hooks ready - waiting for first map precache

Weapons.Idle.Zh: 武器服务端尚未运行；勾选仅代表下次启动配置。
Weapons.Idle.En: Weapon server is not running; checkboxes configure the next launch only.

Weapons.Selected.Zh: 已选择 {0} / {1} 个修复模块，配置在下次启动服务端时生效。
Weapons.Selected.En: Selected {0} / {1} repair modules; changes apply on the next server start.

Network.Mode.Lan.Zh: 我来开服 · 局域网 / VPN

Network.Advertised.Zh: 向玩家通告的对局 IPv4

Network.Help.Local.Zh: 只在本机游玩。大厅地址填 127.0.0.1；其他玩家无法使用这个回环地址连接你。
Network.Help.Local.En: Local play only. Keep the lobby address at 127.0.0.1; other players cannot use this loopback address to reach you.

Network.Help.Lan.Zh: 开服者大厅地址仍填 127.0.0.1。对局 IPv4 填其他玩家可访问的本机局域网或 VPN 地址；多网卡时请自行选择。防火墙需允许大厅 TCP 端口和对局 UDP 端口。
Network.Help.Lan.En: Keep the host lobby address at 127.0.0.1. Advertise this PC’s LAN or VPN IPv4 that players can reach; select the correct adapter if several exist. Allow the lobby TCP port and game UDP port in your firewall.

Network.Help.Internet.Zh: 开服者大厅地址仍填 127.0.0.1；对局 IPv4 填公网 IPv4。路由器须同端口映射大厅 TCP 和对局 UDP 到本机，并放行防火墙。无公网 IPv4 / CGNAT 请使用 VPN；本机及同局域网玩家还需要路由器支持 NAT 回环，或统一使用 VPN 地址。不会自动修改路由器或防火墙。
Network.Help.Internet.En: Keep the host lobby address at 127.0.0.1 and advertise your public IPv4. Forward the lobby TCP and game UDP ports to this PC without changing port numbers, and allow them in the firewall. Use a VPN behind CGNAT. The host and LAN players need NAT loopback, or all players should use the VPN address. Router and firewall settings are not changed automatically.

Network.Help.Join.Zh: 大厅地址填开服者提供的局域网、公网或 VPN 地址，端口与 TLS 按对方配置填写。只准备本机所需资源，不启动本地大厅或 CSOHLDS，不向客户端加载武器 DLL；武器勾选由开服者决定。
Network.Help.Join.En: Enter the host’s LAN, public or VPN address, lobby port and TLS setting. Only local game assets are prepared: no local lobby/CSOHLDS starts and no weapon DLL is loaded into the client. The host controls weapon selection.

Network.HostLoopback.Zh: 开服模式的大厅连接地址请填 127.0.0.1；其他玩家使用的地址填写在“向玩家通告的对局 IPv4”。
Network.HostLoopback.En: In host mode, set the lobby connection to 127.0.0.1. Put the player-facing address in Advertised game IPv4.

Network.AddressInvalid.Zh: 请输入玩家可访问的有效 IPv4；不能是 127.0.0.1、0.0.0.0、广播或组播地址。当前协议不支持对局域名或 IPv6。
Network.AddressInvalid.En: Enter a reachable unicast IPv4, not loopback, 0.0.0.0, broadcast or multicast. This game protocol does not support host domains or IPv6.

Network.JoinNoServer.Zh: 加入模式不会启动本地对局服务器。
Network.JoinNoServer.En: Join mode does not start a local game server.

Network.RemoteWeapons.Zh: 加入远程服务器 · 武器功能由开服者管理
Network.RemoteWeapons.En: Remote server · weapon features are managed by the host

Network.Addresses.Zh: 本机 IPv4：{0}（多个地址时，请选择玩家能够访问的网卡地址）
Network.Addresses.En: Local IPv4: {0} (with multiple addresses, choose the adapter reachable by players)

Network.SaveHostFirst.Zh: 请先保存局域网或互联网开服配置。
Network.SaveHostFirst.En: Save a LAN or Internet hosting configuration first.

Network.Copied.Zh: 已复制联机信息；这不代表外网端口已经连通。
Network.Copied.En: Connection info copied; this does not verify Internet reachability.

Network.DedicatedOnly.Zh: CSOHLDS 已启动 · 未启用武器修复模块
Network.DedicatedOnly.En: CSOHLDS running · no weapon repair modules enabled
